item.text: The defect is confined to the simple-response branch: wildcard origins are made explicit only when a `Cookie` header exists, even if `allow_credentials=True`. I’ll retain the existing cookie-triggered behavior for non-credential configurations, add the credential configuration as an independent trigger, and cover both origin echoing and `Vary` preservation.

import asyncio

from starlette.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

async def request(*, origin: str, cookie: bool, vary: bytes | None = None):
    async def app(scope, receive, send):
        headers = [] if vary is None else [(b\"vary\", vary)]
        await send({\"type\": \"http.response.start\", \"status\": 200, \"headers\": headers})
        await send({\"type\": \"http.response.body\", \"body\": b\"OK\"})

    middleware = CORSMiddleware(app, allow_origins=[\"*\"], allow_credentials=True)
    raw_headers = [(b\"origin\", origin.encode())]
    if cookie:
        raw_headers.append((b\"cookie\", b\"session=value\"))
    scope = {\"type\": \"http\", \"method\": \"GET\", \"headers\": raw_headers}
    messages = []

    async def receive():
        return {\"type\": \"http.request\", \"body\": b\"\", \"more_body\": False}

    async def send(message):
        messages.append(message)

    await middleware(scope, receive, send)
    return dict(messages[0][\"headers\"])

async def main():
    without_cookie = await request(origin=\"https://one.example\", cookie=False)
    with_cookie = await request(origin=\"https://two.example\", cookie=True)
    existing_vary = await request(origin=\"https://three.example\", cookie=False, vary=b\"Accept-Encoding\")

    assert without_cookie[b\"access-control-allow-origin\"] == b\"https://one.example\"
    assert without_cookie[b\"vary\"] == b\"Origin\"
    assert with_cookie[b\"access-control-allow-origin\"] == b\"https://two.example\"
    assert with_cookie[b\"vary\"] == b\"Origin\"
    assert existing_vary[b\"vary\"] == b\"Accept-Encoding, Origin\"
    print(\"direct ASGI CORS checks passed\")

asyncio.run(main())
